normalization: StandardScaler fitted on training audio features only; per-tap background PSD estimated from -340..-100 ms, never future/validation data.
augmentation: Only training background snippets from -940..-400 ms; mixed at nominal +12/+6 dB SNR, original labels weighted 1 and augmented labels 0.7. No validation/test audio in augmentation.
warnings: Historical third pass reused, not a fresh independent recording.
No speech recognition; features are short-window spectrum/attack/decay/noise-relative shape.
Noise suppression cannot guarantee recovery of a tap fully masked by another transient.
Current-room background can differ from future background; needs new-session validation.
For missing audio, fused prediction falls back to existing sensors; test set not reduced.

shuffled_audio_1000.note: Same audio features permuted across held-out examples; empirical negative control, not fresh-data validation.

verification: Saved evaluation model reproduces all 217 predictions; audio scalers fit the correct training subset, mean~0, no nonfinite values; final and evaluated models separate.
